name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship – Technical Diploma
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
summary: Scholarship for eligible girl students admitted to an AICTE-approved technical diploma programme. Seat, family-income and admission conditions apply.
benefits: Up to ₹50,000 per year under published scheme guidelines; verify current cycle and permitted use.

eligibility.applicant: Girl students meeting the current AICTE scheme conditions.

applicationProcess: Apply through NSP during the notified AICTE scholarship cycle.
statusNote: NSP 2026–27 listing shows the technical diploma scheme window through 30 November 2026. Confirm current conditions in the official specifications.

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship – Technical Diploma
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
summary: Support for eligible specially-abled students admitted to an AICTE-approved technical diploma programme.
benefits: Up to ₹50,000 per year under published scheme guidelines; check current specifications and allowances.

eligibility.applicant: Students meeting the scheme's benchmark-disability requirements.

applicationProcess: Apply through NSP when the AICTE diploma scheme is open.
statusNote: NSP 2026–27 listing shows applications through 30 November 2026; check the scheme specifications for disability and institution rules.

name: AICTE Swanath Scholarship – Technical Diploma
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
summary: Support for eligible students in AICTE-approved technical diploma courses who meet the scheme's specified family circumstances, including eligible orphans, wards of parents who died due to COVID-19, or wards of armed forces/CAPF personnel martyred in action, as defined by current rules.
benefits: Up to ₹50,000 per year under published scheme guidelines; verify current eligibility and amount.

eligibility.applicant: Must fall within one of the scheme's defined beneficiary categories.

requiredDocuments: Income and identity documents as requested
applicationProcess: Apply through NSP during the notified cycle.
statusNote: NSP 2026–27 listing shows the technical diploma scheme window through 30 November 2026; verify the exact category definitions.

name: HDFC Bank Parivartan ECSS – Diploma Students
summary: Corporate education assistance for diploma students facing financial difficulty or a personal/family crisis; course and academic criteria apply.
benefits: The official programme page lists diploma-category assistance; confirm current award amount and eligibility.

eligibility.course: Diploma/polytechnic students as specified by the current cycle.
eligibility.marks: Previous-year marks threshold applies; verify current notice.

statusNote: Check the official programme page for current diploma-specific award details and application dates.
